review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one theorem, `finiteType_rename_iff`. It has no simp lemmas, no `@[simp]` attributes and no local simp sets. It is a characterisation theorem, not a rewrite rule, so tagging it `@[simp]` would be unjustified. The `rename_X` and `X_mem_supported` rewrites that the proof uses are existing Mathlib lemmas. I found no missing canonical simp lemma, no wrong orientation, no competing rules and no credible rewrite cycle. I did not search the Mathlib sources, since there was no simp interface in the file to compare against.
